title: Fibrewise dense constant dimension opens
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a scheme morphism and $U\subseteq T$ open such that the restriction is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. There exist opens $V_n\subseteq X$ for $n\in\mathbb N$ such that their inverse-image union is dense in every fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] over $t\in U$, and at every $x\in V_n$ the local topological dimension [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] of the fibre at x is n.

proof.text: Construct V_n as the interior in X of the set of x with f(x) in U and local topological fibre dimension n. Membership implies the required dimension equality by interior_subset.

Fix t in U. Component generic points of the scheme-theoretic fibre are dense by genericPoints.closure. At such a z the closure of z is a maximal irreducible closed subset. Thus z is maximal in the specialization order and has coheight zero. The stalk-dimension/coheight theorem gives ringKrullDim of the fibre stalk equal to zero.

Let x be the image of z in X. The fibre homeomorphism gives f(x)=t, and injectivity of fibre inclusion identifies asFiber x with z. Apply the zero-dimensional-stalk neighbourhood theorem to x. It gives n and an open W containing x on which f(y) lies in U and the fibre dimension is n. Since W is open and contained in this level set, W is contained in its interior V_n. Hence the inverse-image union of the V_n contains every fibre generic point. Density follows by Dense.mono.

from.place: Slicing and relative connectedness: spreading the generic closed-fibre geometry; the Tag 054X density argument after the generic-flatness preparation. Specifically: Fibre dimension along a specialization from a component point. Constant-dimension neighbourhood step, via the opens of Tag 054T.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_fibre_dimension_opens_of_flat_restrict
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)] :
    ∃ V : ℕ → X.Opens,
      (∀ t : T, t ∈ U → Dense {z : f.fiber t | ∃ n : ℕ, f.fiberι t z ∈ V n}) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : X), x ∈ V n →
        topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
